title: Sprint cycles are a bounding gait: the animated body is airborne 60-75% of the time at only 1.5-2.0 steps per second (floating run)
evidence: MEASURED (48 real plays, 60 Hz, bones). motion_summary.txt gait bins: CB Sprint 7.5 m/s 1.88 steps/s, stride 4.18 m, flight 0.71; S Sprint 7.5 m/s 1.65 steps/s, 4.74 m, flight 0.72; LB Sprint 7.5 m/s 2.02 steps/s, 3.84 m, flight 0.73; WR Carry 7.5 m/s 1.91 steps/s, 3.94 m, flight 0.69; WR Route 7.5 m/s 1.49 steps/s, 5.10 m, flight 0.75. Real sprinting: 4.3-4.7 steps/s, stride 2.0-2.4 m, flight about 50%. Visible in strips rb_outside_run_Side.png frames 5-8 and tackle_carrier_Side.png (both feet clear of the turf)
fix: Re-time the sprint / carry-sprint cycles from the measured contact table: scrub the cycle so cadence is at least 3.8 steps/s at 7.5 m/s (animator speed = sim speed / clip stride length, not the blend-tree weights), cap clip stride at 2.5 m, and flag any sprint take whose flight fraction is above 0.55 as unusable in AnimAudit

title: Run and jog cycles have a too-low cadence and a too-long stride at 4.5 m/s (glide)
evidence: MEASURED gait bins at 4.5 m/s: WR Route 2.99 steps/s, stride 1.77 m; CB Run 2.56 steps/s, 2.05 m; LB Run 2.52, 2.06 m; S Run 2.23, 2.36 m; RB Carry 1.95, 2.76 m; DL Run 2.55, 1.99 m. Real jog at 4.5 m/s: about 3.3 steps/s, stride about 1.35 m.
fix: Re-key the cycle speeds table (CycleSpeeds / LocomotionAnimator.StrideTrim) so each clip plays at ground-speed / measured stride; add a jog cycle between the 1.7 m/s jog and the 6.5 m/s run (the tree has nothing between); verify with the treadmill + EngineAudit gait bins (target stride 1.2-1.6 m at 4.5 m/s)

title: Planted feet slide on every ground contact at run speeds (skating): minimum toe speed during a contact is 0.5-1.5 m/s, target below 0.3
evidence: MEASURED contact min slide (m/s), motion_summary.txt: CB Run 3 m/s mean 0.52, 4.5 m/s 0.99 (p50 0.80), 6 m/s 1.50 (p50 1.16); LB Run 4.5 m/s 1.03, 6 m/s 1.40; S Run 4.5 m/s 0.97, 6 m/s 1.06; DL Run 1.5 m/s 2.01. Same order as the v0.7 treadmill (anim_qb.md) so the v0.7 "foot lock / stride trim" did not move real-play numbers
fix: Per-foot stance-phase IK pin (LimbIK) active whenever the foot is below 4 cm, hips pushed down by the unreachable amount, and stride matching ON for all gaits (BodyMotion.StrideMatchEnabled is false); gate on contact height not on 0.65 m/s

title: No start-from-standstill clip in the shared tree
evidence: `Editor/Build/AnimatorControllerBuilder.cs:121-128` tree = idle + walk/jog/run/sprint + shuffles only; `Player/LocomotionAnimator.cs:86-87` velocity low-pass tau 0.11 s; `ArtKeys.WalkStart/StanceToSprint` only reached through `AnimKit.GetOff` (see #9)
fix: Add accel-phase clips (stance_to_sprint, walk_start) as a state entered when smoothed speed rises from under 0.5 m/s with sim accel above a threshold; scale by sim acceleration, not time

title: 90 degree cut at sprint takes 0.88 s, loses 53 percent of speed and overshoots 3.9 yd downfield (looks like ice-skating)
evidence: `AgentBody.cs:117` `LatBase = (8.5f + 5.5f * Agility01) * ...`; `:236` `latCap = LatBase * (1f - 0.40f * speed/VMax)`; `:245-254` plant-and-cut bleed; `:257` `tractionLimit = AccelCap + 1.5f + 2f * Agility01`. Derived (RB 92): 45 degrees 0.52 s / 80 percent, 90 degrees 0.88 s / 47 percent, 135 degrees min 14 percent
fix: `LatBase = (16 + 7 x Agi) x pace`, speed term 0.20 (from 0.40), `DecelBase = (12 + 5 x Agi)`, `TurnRate x 1.2`, `tractionLimit = AccelCap + 5 + 3 x Agi`: derived 0.53 s / 51 percent / 2.6 yd overshoot; add "brake into the cut" like `RunRoute` (row 66)

title: No interpolation between fixed 60 Hz sim steps and the render frame
evidence: `Sim/PlaySimulation.cs:348-370` accumulates `dt` and steps at `Dt = 1/60`; `PlayStage.cs:266-281` and `Gameplay/Player/SimAgentView.cs:177` write the last stepped `a.Pos` to `transform.position` with no alpha; on 120/144 Hz or any frame that runs 0 or 2 steps the body position moves in uneven jumps while the animation advances smoothly, which reads as foot slide and "floating"
fix: Expose `PlaySimulation.Alpha = _accum / Dt` and keep the previous step's positions/facing; the view lerps `prev -> cur` by alpha (and extrapolates velocity for the locomotion drive).

title: Sprinting defenders slide backwards at about 2 m/s per contact (CB / LB / S Sprint)
evidence: MEASURED contact min slide, Sprint action: CB mean 2.12 (p50 2.39), LB 2.22 (p50 2.07), S 1.93 (p50 1.64), max 6.2 m/s; sim speed is 7.5-8.5 m/s so the sprint take is not matched to ground speed

title: Defensive back-pedal cadence is half of a real back-pedal and the stride is 2.3-3.4 m (the feet glide)

title: Acceleration cap is too strong: 8.5 + 4 x accel01 reaches 12.5 yd/s2 (11.4 m/s2, more than an elite sprinter) and the DL keeps 12.0 at pace 1.0; first steps are explosive from pads

title: Braking and traction are above a human limit (DecelBase up to 13.5 yd/s2 = 1.26 g, traction limit up to 16) so defenders "stop on a dime" and cuts do not look heavy

title: Turn rate is 540 deg/s standing and about 270 deg/s at full speed: hips snap around, DB turn-and-run is nearly instant

title: Lateral shuffle is 0.60-0.71 of top speed: a CB shuffles 6.2-6.7 yd/s (about 13 mph) and a 315 lb OL kick-slides at about 5.4 yd/s; real shuffle is 8-10 mph, kick-slide 3.5-4.5 yd/s

title: One spin rate for every pass and kick

title: A committed throw cannot be pumped or aborted; the window is 0.26-0.42 s
evidence: `Qb.cs:670-695` (no re-evaluation between `BeginThrow` and `ReleaseThrow`)

title: Contested-catch pair restarts the receiver's catch animation on the catch frame
evidence: `PlayStage.Flow.cs:34-43` starts the in-place catch 0.34 s early (hands together on the catch frame); then `ContactDirector.cs:105-106,206-222` `StartSession(Contested)` replays a different catch (`:265` `Rig.Play(clipA, s.Start, ...)`) at the same frame, losing the sync that v0.7 note 30 fixed
fix: Do not start a contested session when the receiver already plays the early catch; instead start the paired take at `CatchReachSeconds` before arrival (so the pair contact IS the catch frame), or skip the pair and add a tiny defender reach/bump.

title: The contested-catch pair owns the receiver for 2 to 3 s while the sim runs him downfield
evidence: `ContactDirector.cs:220` session for the whole clip; `ContactSession.cs:41` finishes at `max(lenA, lenB)` (A 2.0 to 3.0 s, B up to 5.75 s; `PixContact.asset` lines 98016-101216); the view root slides to the sim via the Authority ramp (`ContactSession.cs:96`)

title: Punt returners carry the ball in the quarterback hold pose
evidence: `Gameplay/Match/PlayStage.cs:402-404` `qbPass /  / Sim.Kind == FieldGoal /  / Sim.Kind == Punt` then `Ball.SetQbHold(...)` for ANY holder, so after a punt (or a blocked/missed FG return) the returner's ball sits between both hands (`BallFollower.cs:161`) instead of on the tuck arm
fix: Restrict the QB hold branch to the QB/punter/holder agents (slot 0 or the kicker) and to pre-kick states; use `SetCarry` for everybody after the kick.

title: Ball is far from the hands at the moment of the catch and in the pocket
evidence: MEASURED ball to nearest hand while the sim says the player holds the ball: WR Catch p95 0.66 m (mean 0.16), TE Catch p95 0.64, RB Catch p95 0.90, QB Idle p95 0.65, QB Handoff p95 0.34; RB Carry 0.05 m (fine)

title: Ball jumps from the extended hands to the forearm at the catch
evidence: `Gameplay/Match/BallFollower.cs:165-174` the carry mode attaches to the forearm, there is no hand-hold mode for a catch (`QbHold`/`Hand` exist); blended only 0.12 s

title: Catch pose is chosen from variants only; hands do not reach the real ball
evidence: `Player/AnimKit.cs:246-268` picks by tokens from `BallLocalDir/BallHeight`; `Player/LimbIK.cs` used only for carriage and stiff arm; no hand IK to `Ball.Position`

title: Catch key list excludes dive, contested, one-hand, toe-tap, fair catch

title: Contested catch is picked for any defender within 1.9 yd and always "receiver wins" with a stationary jump pose
evidence: `ContactDirector.cs:211` `bd = 1.9f`; `:210` only offense receivers; `Choose` has no speed filter beyond the 0.18 per m/s penalty; contested pairs have `speedA` 0.0 to 1.1 and `tContact` 0.1 to 0.25, so `Lead = min(0.18, tContact)` (`ContactSession.cs:48`) gives a 0.1 s warp for a receiver running 6 m/s

title: No contested pair for interceptions, deflections, drops, breakups
evidence: `ContactDirector.cs:97-115` handles Tackle, BrokenTackle, Catch (offense only), Pancake, CarrierMove; `Sim/SimTypes.cs:25-33` also has Interception, Deflection, Drop, Jam, QbHit, Fumble, Recovery which no view code reacts to (grep of `SimEventType.*` in Gameplay/Presentation finds only audio and commentary)

title: Fumbled ball pops when the displayed carrier is offset from the sim body

title: Switching the carry arm teleports the ball across the body

title: Defensive backs get no read-ahead for catches and jump balls are late

title: Catch is awarded while the ball is up to about 1 yd from the hands
evidence: `CatchResolver.cs:53` `r = a.Body.Radius + 0.62f` (+0.45f for low balls, line 54); `PlaySimulation.Catch.cs:11` `GiveBall(r)`; hidden only by a 0.12 s blend (`Gameplay/Match/BallFollower.cs:30,136`)

title: Receiver stops dead under the ball: speed is forced to 0 within 0.35 yd of the landing spot

title: Receiver abandons his route and beelines to the landing spot, facing the direction of travel until 2 yd
evidence: `OffenseAI.cs:433-444` (`a.Want = to.Norm() * speed`; `FaceDir = to.Norm()` when `dist2 > 2.0f && tt > 0.55f`)

title: Ball orientation snaps at every attach
evidence: `BallFollower.cs:136-137` blends only the position offset (`_attachOffset`), then `SetPositionAndRotation` sets the full carry rotation (`:174`) so the flight spin to hold orientation is instantaneous

title: Interception and fumble-recovery catches have no commit window or speed cap

title: Ball carrier re-picks his lane every 0.07-0.23 s with only a weak continuity bonus, so he flips direction mid-run

title: Catch commit window suppresses the juke/stiff-arm/truck/spin that follows a catch

title: Ball carrier holds the ball in the arm "away from the defender" only for the ball, not the pose

title: Stiff-arm win ragdolls the defender even though the sim only stumbles him

title: Carry pose is a forearm lerp with world-axis offsets, no per-body fit, no hand grip

title: LaneFinder sees only defenders (no blockers, holes or cutback lanes), so runners bounce to open grass and drift along the LOS

title: Carrier AI has no clock, first-down or sideline logic: it avoids the sideline, never steps out of bounds, never dives for the sticks

title: Pulled pair pops back when the engagement ends
evidence: `PlayStage.cs:304-305,310` the pull is applied only while Action is Engaged/Shed/Tackled, with no ramp-out (`w` goes from 1 to 0 in one frame); up to 0.45 m / 0.7 m pops at every shed and release
fix: Keep a per-agent pull weight that decays over 0.2 s after the engagement ends.

title: Rush moves are random picks with no link to alignment, matchup geometry or weight; a 300 lb DT has the same spin weight (0.4) as an edge
evidence: `BlockEngagement.cs:451-465`
fix: Weight moves by mass, alignment (inside/outside), set-up move -> counter chain; Speed only from outside shoulder

title: Pass-pro assignment is a greedy cost sort with no left-to-right order: blockers can cross assignments (slide sends the tackle to the guard's man, the cause of B-013's 8.7 sacks), unlike run blocks which use a monotone DP
evidence: `BlockerAI.cs:176-185` (greedy); `:81-128` (monotone DP for runs)
fix: Reuse `MonotoneMatch` for the line, then assign the back/TE to the unmatched rusher (Mike identification)

title: Pass-pro blockers do not set or kick-slide: they chase the rusher to a point 0.28 yd in front of him, up to LOS + 0.9 yd, so the line meets rushers at the line and never gives ground until locked
evidence: `BlockerAI.cs:261-267` (`gp`, `lim = LosY + 0.9f`)
fix: Set point 0.5-1.0 yd behind the LOS, kick back 1.5-2.0 yd/s mirroring the rusher's outside shoulder, punch on contact

title: Run blocks win by default: bias = 0.30 (+0.22 vs LBs) gives an equilibrium Lev of +1.12 for equal ratings, so an even matchup reaches the pancake threshold in about 3 s
fix: Run bias 0.12 (+0.08 vs LBs); pancake needs Lev >= 1 for 0.5 s and gap > 0.15

title: Pass-mode pancake uses a per-tick probability: NextFloat() < 0.03f at 60 Hz is about 84 % per second once Lev >= 0.85 for 0.9 s
evidence: `BlockEngagement.cs:339`
fix: `0.0006f` per tick (about 3.5 % per second)

title: Engagement is a single scalar with no geometry: no leverage, angle, depth of the blocker's hands or which side of the defender he is on; Lev only reflects ratings plus noise
evidence: `BlockEngagement.cs:286-306`
fix: Add geometric term: `dot(drive, line(defender->hole))` and blocker-hip-ahead-of-defender factor to `gap`; reached-on / hooked outcomes

title: Combo (double-team) blocks last 0.25 s before one blocker peels, whether or not the linebacker threatens
evidence: `BlockEngagement.cs:355` `e.Age > 0.25f`
fix: Keep both blockers >= 0.8 s, peel only when the LB is within 2.5 yd and the DL Lev < 0

title: Any free blocker can join any engaged defender: the comment says doubles are limited to an adjacent lineman or the assigned blocker but the code only checks Count < 2; joiners overwrite their own BlockTargetId, leaving their man free
evidence: `BlockEngagement.cs:173,185,228`
fix: Join only if `b.BlockTargetId == d.Id` or his target is null/beaten and abs(dx) < 2.2

title: Zone blocking is a static 1:1 monotone match at the snap and then re-picks every 0.16-0.28 s; man blocks have only a +1.0 stickiness, so targets thrash between nearby defenders
fix: Lock the target for 0.6 s unless it is beaten/occupied; zone step + double-team hand-off (playside combo, then climb)

title: Pulling blockers run their path from tick 1 at 0.95 vmax, the first waypoint is 1.3 yd behind the LOS next to the QB spot, so pulls collide with the QB/RB and have no first-step lag
evidence: `BlockerAI.cs:314-322`; `DefaultPlaybooks.Offense.cs:153` `P(sx*0.35f, -1.3f)`
fix: 0.12 s lead step, first waypoint y = -0.7, ramp speed 0.6 -> 0.95 over 0.5 s, ghost QB/RB for the exchange

title: Pass-rush moves: Rip and Speed play the swim take, wrong-arm never plays, last pose held
evidence: `Player/AnimKit.cs:196` `Swim/Rip/Speed -> dl_rush_swim`, `dl_rush_rip`/`dl_wrong_arm` unused; `:206` `Hold = true` window 4.2 s
fix: Map moves 1:1, loop the engaged hand-fight idle after the take instead of freezing

title: Chip blocks release by clock (0.9 s) regardless of the edge man's state, so the back leaves while the end is free or still stalemated
evidence: `BlockerAI.cs:211-215`
fix: Release when the edge defender's Lev > 0.3 or t > 1.4 s

title: Run blockers with no target run to a point 4 yd past the carrier, dragging linemen across the formation instead of finding second-level work
evidence: `BlockerAI.cs:278-284` `goal = c.Pos + (0, 4*up)`
fix: Seek nearest unblocked LB/S within 7 yd on the play side

title: Defense press: jam hands exist only on the stance and drop at the snap
evidence: `Player/SimAgentView.cs:198-199` Jam carriage only while `action == Stance`; `ArtKeys.PressJam`, `WrRelease` zero uses; `Sim/SimTypes.cs:29` `SimEventType.Jam` has no view consumer
fix: Press jam state (0.4 s) after the snap for CB within 1 yd with the WR release take for the receiver; consume the Jam event

title: Defenders (interception, pass breakup) get their reach too late and with the wrong clip
evidence: `Gameplay/Match/PlayStage.Flow.cs:34` early reach only for `Side == Offense && Intended == i`; defenders start at the sim `Catch`/`Jump` with fallback lead 0.1 (`Player/AnimKit.V7.cs:95`) and a 0.22 fade; `Player/AnimKit.cs:291` swat = `catch_jump`; `ArtKeys.Swat` unused
fix: Predict the defender's play on the ball (ETA to ball under 0.35 s and defender is closest), use interception/swat takes, start them ahead like the receiver

title: CB treated as "press" out to 3.2 yd
evidence: `Player/StanceRules.cs:100` and `Sim/PreSnapStances.cs:54` `depth <= 3.2f`; spec "Directly across, 0-1 yd"
fix: Press up to 1.2 yd, "bail"/soft-press 1.2-3 yd with the off stance and hands at the hips

title: No turn-and-run, hip flip or break-on-ball for coverage
evidence: `ArtKeys.ManTurnRun`, `CbBreak` (only the forward get-off), `CbRotate`, `LbReadStep`, `ZoneDrop` unused; `Player/AnimKit.Extra.cs:113` `BreakOnBall` zero callers; `Sim/PlaySimulation.cs:639-640` Backpedal -> Shuffle -> Run just blends
fix: Trigger the turn clips on the Backpedal->Run/Shuffle edge (angle above 1.0 rad), break-on-ball when the DB's ETA to the ball is short

title: Zone defenders play man: once a receiver is in the (width/2 + 2.5) catchment the zone defender leaves the landmark and keeps a 0.9 yd cushion, after only 0.25 s
evidence: `DefenseAI.cs:573,586-587` `cushion = 0.9f + 0.5f*...`; `:548` `halfW = z.Width*0.5f + 2.5f`
fix: Hold landmark depth, shade laterally, cushion 2.5-3 yd underneath, break only on the receiver entering the zone center

title: Zone drops: straight line to the landmark at 0.95 vmax from the snap, no pedal/gather/turn, then an abrupt stop (speed = 0 at 0.4 yd)
evidence: `DefenseAI.cs:593-598` `speed = Math.Min(vmax*0.95f, Math.Max(1.2f, dist2*4.5f))`
fix: Drop phases: pedal 0.35 s at 0.55 vmax facing QB, then settle (decel over 1 yd); deep zones turn at 0.5 s

title: Underneath assignments send a linebacker 11 yd to a flat: AllocUnder sorts by x and gives the leftmost defender FlatLeft (x = -17); Cover 3 LOLB at x = -6 must cross 11 yd in about 2 s
evidence: `DefaultPlaybooks.Defense.cs:116-125`, `:104-114`; `Playbook.cs:193-194`
fix: Flats only to CB/SS/nickel; LBs get hook/curl; if there are 4 underneath use curl/flat + two hooks by position

title: Deep zones never pass receivers off; two deep defenders can both lock on the same crosser
evidence: `DefenseAI.cs:564` `if (!deep && CoveredByTeammate(a, rp, dist)) continue;`
fix: Apply `CoveredByTeammate` to deep with a vertical-stack rule (one over, one under) and hand off at the zone seam x

title: No bracket/help coverage or post-snap safety rotation: Cover 1 free safety is a static deep-middle landmark, Cover 2 never rotates to 3 on trips/motion, robber is a fixed 7 yd zone
evidence: `DefaultPlaybooks.Defense.cs:234-240` (Cover 1), `:206` Robber; `DefenseAI.cs:377-491` (no help logic)
fix: Add `Help` role: FS cheats toward the most vertical receiver (`tgt.Vel.Y > 0.7 vmax`), safety rotation table keyed to formation (trips, motion)

title: Cover 4 / Match / Cover 6 are plain spot-drop zones; no pattern matching (read #2 vertical or out) despite the Match names
evidence: `DefaultPlaybooks.Defense.cs:287-304,431-432`; `DefenseAI.cs:547-569`
fix: MOD rule: quarter safety picks #2 if vertical within 7 yd, else helps over #1; CB sticks #1 vertical

title: Off-man cushion collapses on a timer, not on the receiver: from 6+ yd to 1.5 yd between 0.4 s and 1.9 s whether the receiver is running a go or a hitch
evidence: `DefenseAI.cs:446-449` `Lerp(startCushion, 1.5f, Clamp01((t-0.4f)/1.5f))`
fix: cushion = clamp(`rv.Y * 0.6 s`, 1.5, 7.5) vs vertical threats; close only after the receiver stops or breaks

title: Press technique is stand-still plus dice: corner holds Want = 0 up to 0.32 s, then the jam is a logistic roll that directly shoves the receiver Knock(1.6 yd/s) and halves his velocity (Vel*0.5), with no foot movement or contact
fix: Mirror the release by 1-step shuffle, require overlap < r1+r2+0.2 for the jam, steer the WR path 1.2 yd over 0.25 s instead of the velocity set

title: Ball reaction: every responsible defender (resp >= 0.45) runs to the earliest reachable point of the ball flight, not to the receiver's catch point; man DBs and zone defenders stack on the same spot
evidence: `DefenseAI.cs:660-671` (`found` break on first reachable point); `:635-637`
fix: Man DB targets the receiver's hands (contact point from inside hip); zone: nearest two only, others hold the lane

title: Zone landmarks and regions are ball-relative, not field-relative: with the ball on a hash the boundary third loses about 3 yd and the field third extends past the sideline; landmark is clamped to x in [3, 50.3]
evidence: `Playbook.cs:200-213` (e.g. `DeepThirdRight CenterX = 17.8`); `DefenseAI.cs:54-55`
fix: Anchor thirds/halves/quarters to field center and sidelines (width 53.3), keep hook/flat ball-relative

title: A safety matched in man keeps his formation depth (9-12 yd) regardless of the call, so a Cover 0/1 strong safety over the TE plays 9 yd off
evidence: `DefenseAlignment.cs:115-119` `a.StartPos.Y - s.LosY`
fix: Man safety depth 6-7 on a TE/back, FS free 11-13

title: CurlLeft/Right zones are never assigned; hooks sit at 8-9 yd, shallow of the 10-12 yd real hook/curl
evidence: `Playbook.cs:195-199`; `DefaultPlaybooks.Defense.cs:104-114`
fix: Use Curl (depth 11) in Cover 3/4 and Hook at 10; add flat at 5

title: Pass interference is one dice roll when the ball reaches the receiver: any non-rusher within 2.1 yd of the target can draw it, no contact or hand-fighting required
evidence: `CatchResolver.cs:96-126`
fix: Require body overlap `<= r1+r2+0.25` for 0.15 s and the DB trailing/not looking; p max 0.12

title: Every authored tackle is slower than the game: a sprinting carrier stops dead at contact
evidence: `Gameplay/Contact/TackleVariants.cs:92` `score -= Mathf.Abs(p.speedA - s.CarrierSpeed) * 0.18f` (a soft penalty, no filter); `ContactDirector.cs:251` speed estimate; `ContactSession.cs:53` `predA = simA + simVelA * (s.Lead * 0.6f)` (only 0.11 s of momentum); table max `speedA` 4.5 m/s while sim skill speed is about 8.4 m/s
fix: Hard-filter or heavily weight `speedA`; for carrier speed above 5 m/s add a momentum carry-through: keep sim locomotion until contact, then slide both bodies 0.6 to 1.5 m along the incoming velocity with an eased decay (and foot-slip pitch on the tackler). Re-time the take root with a speed scale so the carrier does not decelerate from 8 to 3 m/s inside 0.18 s.

title: A second tackler on a carrier who is still in a Broken take only adds a "gang" joiner; the carrier never goes down in the picture
evidence: `Gameplay/Contact/ContactDirector.cs:137-150` (`existing != null` and `!drag` goes to `AddJoiner` and returns), `:152`, `:159-167`; Broken A clips last 0.9 to 2.4 s so this is common after every shoestring or broken tackle; once clip A ends the carrier idles in `ContactDriven` while the sim says Tackled
fix: If the existing session kind is Broken (or SackBroken), end it (`EndSession`) and start a Wrap or Sack session for the new tackler; never join a session whose carrier clip is not a tackle fall.

title: The beaten tackler of a Broken take is dragged along the ground by the carrier's sim progress
evidence: `Gameplay/Contact/ContactSession.cs:96-99` (`corr = delta * k` is added to `rootA` and `rootB`, `delta = simA - animHipsA`); Authority ramps in from `tContact + 0.3` (`ContactSession.cs:35`)
fix: Apply the authority correction to the carrier only; give B its own anchor (its sim position blended once, then fixed to the take), or clamp B's correction so a lying defender never translates more than a few cm.

title: A clean tackle sets the carrier Down, Fall(1.1), cuts his velocity to 55 % and the tackler to 35 % on the same tick; the limiter only spreads it over 3-5 ticks
evidence: `TackleResolver.cs:331-343`; `PlaySimulation.cs:64,505-509`
fix: Phase it: contact decel over 0.2 s, fall at 0.25 s, momentum-conserving velocities `(m_c v_c + m_t v_t)/(m_c+m_t)`; CONNECT adds `TackleApproach` at 2.0 yd

title: Pass-rush and coverage closing speeds at contact show defenders arriving at full speed head-on (no gather)
evidence: MEASURED pursuit closing speed to the carrier within 3 yd: mean 2.8 yd/s, p95 11.4, p99 13.5, max 16.5 yd/s (a 33 mph collision); S mean closing 4.3 yd/s at 12 yd; DL mean -2.2
fix: Add a break-down / gather phase for defenders inside 3 yd (speed capped at 60% with a shortened stride); see defense review rows 45, 67

title: Generic tackle: tackler and carrier choose independent A takes
evidence: `Player/AnimKit.cs:330-331` `a = best[h.Seed % best.Count]` per actor then `TwinOf` for the carrier; only masked when ContactDirector owns the pair (`PlayStage.cs:303`)
fix: Same pair seed (tackler id + carrier id) for both

title: Stumble action has no clip
evidence: `Player/SimAgentView.cs:211-229` switch has no `Stumble`; `Priority` gives it 3 (`SimAgentView.Flow.cs:44`); sim sets it after trucks and hurdles (`Sim/CarrierMoves.cs:231-235,253`)
fix: Stumble/recover take (0.4-0.55 s), lean forward with arm windmill

title: Fallen has no get-up: the held fall pose pops to a run
evidence: `Player/AnimKit.cs:337-341` fall window 2 s, `hold = true`; `Player/SimAgentView.cs:236` `Rig.Stop(0.18)` into locomotion when the sim action changes; get-ups exist only in `Gameplay/Contact/ContactDirector.cs:36,68-69` for pair takes
fix: Generic fall->lie->get-up sequence (`getup_*` unused) keyed off `Fallen` end

title: Tackle take starts a fixed 0.55 s in, not at its contact moment
evidence: `Player/AnimKit.cs:333` `start = 0.55 / 0.5 / 0` by key; no `ClipTimingTable` moment (cf. catches and throws)
fix: Per-take impact frame in the timing table, start = impact - sim approach ETA

title: View yaw of a contact actor never hands back to the simulation
evidence: `ContactSession.cs:89` takes `simYawA` and `simYawB` but `:103-104` only lerps `StartYawA/B` to `Align.Yaw`; the arguments are unused. A broken-tackle carrier keeps running (sim) while facing the fixed take yaw until `Finished`. `ContactDirector.cs:382-383`
fix: Blend yaw back to the sim facing with the same Authority ramp (after tContact + hold), and run the carrier locomotion facing off the blended yaw.

title: Carrier is locked out of the match animation logic until the longer clip B finishes
evidence: `ContactSession.cs:41` `Finished = Time >= EndA && Time >= EndB`; `Gameplay/Player/SimAgentView.cs:201` `if (ContactDriven) { _lastAction = action; ... return; }`; Broken table: A 0.9 to 2.4 s vs B 2.2 to 4.2 s. During that time the carrier cannot juke, stiff-arm, hurdle, catch or react to a second hit
fix: Release the carrier (`ContactDriven=false`, `Rig.Stop`) at `EndA`, keep the session alive only for the B actor.

title: Get-up part of every tackle take is never seen: whistle wind and fade cut it
evidence: `Gameplay/Match/MatchDirector.cs:679` `wind = ... 2.9f` (4.2 s TD), `:703` `Fade(1f, 0.22f)`, `:704` `Stage.End()`; table `getUp` for Wrap takes 2.6 to 5.8 s (median about 4.2 s) after take start
fix: Hold the post-play window until the last tackled player is upright (or at least until `getUp + 0.6`), or let `LivePlay` end with a walk-away and have the next BeginPlay wait for it; cap with a 6 s budget.

title: Tackle variant choice ignores tackler height, body size, closing direction and carrier carry state
evidence: `Gameplay/Contact/TackleVariants.cs:36-45` `KindFor` maps WrapUp/GangTackle/Drag/PushOutOfBounds all to Wrap and `:63-79` Wrap requires "High" in the clip name; `lowB`/`lowA`/`distance`/`closingA` in `Art/ContactTable.cs:28-34` are never read; Score is bearing, speed, closing only (`:88-98`)
fix: Score on `lowB` vs the sim tackle type (Dive/Shoestring wants high lowB, WrapUp wants low), body-size ratio and `distance`; keep a recent-history penalty so the same take is not reused twice in a row per team.

title: No mirroring: a side that has no authored variant plays the wrong side take
evidence: `Gameplay/Contact/TackleVariants.cs:88-98` (only `DeltaAngle(p.bearing, s.Bearing)`); `ContactMath.cs` has no mirror transform; Big-hit Success takes are all at -75 to -56 deg, contested catches only 6 bearings
fix: Add a mirror flag (negate authored x and yaw, mirror bone rotations via Humanoid mirror clip twin or `Animator.isMirror`-style graph) so any bearing has a matching pair.

title: Big hits reuse 3 takes, all from the carrier's left, and "Failure" takes are never used
evidence: `TackleVariants.cs:73` (`ContactBigHit` and `Has(n,"Success")`); `Assets/_Licensed/Resources/PixContact.asset` lines 91186, 94691, 95221 (the 3 matches); 89976, 91931, 93211 (unused Failure takes); sim big-hit share 14.7 percent (`Docs/QA/v080/sim_abilities.md:74`)
fix: Use Failure/CriticalFailure takes for a big hit the carrier shrugs off (pair with `BrokenTackle`), add mirroring (row 8), and add a per-seed variety rule (never the same hit twice in 5 hits).

title: SackBroken, Truck and Collision pair kinds are never produced
evidence: `ContactDirector.cs:153-156` (`KindFor` only returns Sack for `sackFollows`); `:159-167` any broken tackle is `ContactKind.Broken`; `:169-177` Truck only calls `Knock`; no call site for `ContactKind.Truck/Collision/SackBroken` (repo-wide grep). 14 SackBroken + 5 Collision + about 15 Truck-style Omo takes are dead data
fix: Route a BrokenTackle on the QB to SackBroken; route the Truck event to a `Truck` pair (carrier + defender); route blocker/DB-WR shoulder contacts to `Collision`.

title: Sack takes depend on the Sack event being the very next log entry
evidence: `Gameplay/Match/PlayStage.cs:243` `ev[_logIdx].Type == SimEventType.Sack`; sim logs Tackle then Sack only when nothing else logs between (`Sim/TackleResolver.cs:358-379`); a Flag/Fumble entry in between makes the QB play a plain Wrap
fix: Resolve the sack from the Tackle event itself (carrier slot 0 and has ball and `!PassIsThrown`) or scan forward up to 3 events for the same ids.

title: A dragged (held) take is a frozen statue that slides with the carrier
evidence: `ContactDirector.cs:376` `Hold(true)` + `SetFrozen(true)` at `HoldAt = tContact + 0.5f` (`:262`); `ContactSession.cs:96` `k = Held ? 1f : ...` pins both bodies to the moving sim carrier. A-009 (`Docs/QA/v070/anim_qb.md`) only fixed the post-whistle release
fix: Do not freeze: loop a 0.5 s "struggle" sub-window of the wrap take (ping-pong) with root motion off, or switch to a drag-specific walk-with-tackler layer; keep the tackler's feet moving at carrier speed.

title: Gang tackle joiners are not matched to the carrier's actual pose, timeline or to each other
evidence: `ContactDirector.cs:283-305`: joiner uses the B clip of an unrelated Wrap pair aligned to the sim carrier position (`:300`), starts at `tContact - 0.18` while the primary take may already be mid-fall (`:299`), and only avoids the primary pair (`:292`), so two joiners can pick the same pair and stack identically
fix: Pick the joiner pair so its A pose matches the primary's current phase; keep a `usedPairs` set; delay the joiner to the primary's `tContact + 0.3`; give joiners an offset/mirror so no two share a transform.

title: Pairs are aligned by hips only and ignore body size, so S/M/L and OL/DB hits gap or interpenetrate
evidence: `ContactMath.cs:46-57` `AlignPair` uses authored hip points; `ContactDirector.cs:261` no size input; table `distance` varies 0.24 to 1.7 m (`PixContact.asset`) and the roster has 15 body kinds (`Gameplay/Match/PlayStage.cs:119`)
fix: Scale the authored separation by the ratio of the two bodies' pelvis widths and add a hand/chest IK pass (the stiff-arm IK in `ContactDirector.cs:188` is the pattern) to put the tackler's hands on the carrier's torso.

title: The warp from sim to take is a 0.18 s position and yaw snap
evidence: `ContactSession.cs:48-50,101-104` and `ContactMath.cs:70-74` `WarpIn` over `tContact - Start` (0.18 s, 0.04 s minimum); the take yaw can differ from the carrier heading by up to about 100 deg (`AlignPair` axis weight 0.6, `ContactMath.cs:46-57`) and the tackler moves up to the full sim to take gap
fix: Pre-roll the alignment over 0.35 to 0.5 s before contact (start the take earlier, it has lead-in frames), limit yaw rate to 540 deg/s and position pull to a plausible stride.

title: Ragdoll runs in FixedUpdate at 50 Hz with no interpolation
evidence: `Gameplay/Contact/RagdollRig.cs:72` `interpolation = None`, `:241-252` FixedUpdate, `:288-331` LateUpdate copies `Rb.position`; project fixed step is 0.02 s (`ProjectSettings/TimeManager.asset` Fixed Timestep 2822399/141120000)
fix: Enable `RigidbodyInterpolation.Interpolate` on all parts, or step the ragdoll manually with `Physics.Simulate` at the render dt, or lerp bone poses between the last two physics states.

title: The ragdoll is built lazily on the first hit of each view and hitches that frame
evidence: `RagdollRig.cs:205` `if (!_built) Build();` inside `Begin`; `Build` (`:158-193`) swaps every bone to bind pose, adds 11 rigidbodies, colliders and joints; 22 views times a pool means up to 22 hitches in a game
fix: Build all rigs during `Stage.Warm` (and for every pooled view) behind the loading/toss screen.

title: The ragdoll rides along with the sim agent through the view root (verify in play)
evidence: `Gameplay/Player/SimAgentView.cs:177` `transform.position = position` is applied every frame for a `ContactDriven` view while the ragdoll bones are children of that root; `RagdollRig.cs:302-304` re-writes bones from `Rb.position` only in LateUpdate. A stiff-arm shoved defender is still running in the sim (`Sim/CarrierMoves.cs:234-236` `Stumble(0.55)`)
fix: Detach the ragdoll from the view root while active (root frozen at the Begin pose, `SimAgentView` skips `transform.position`), and re-parent at Recover.

title: Get-up take is a random pick over all pairs by face-up sign only
evidence: `ContactDirector.cs:64-70` builds `_getUps` from every tackle/sack/big-hit actor with `getUp > 0.3`; `:330-336` picks by a hash score; only `(g.FaceUp > 0f) != faceUp` is checked, no body orientation (side, curled, arm positions), no clip type; `:339-341` falls back to `SnapToGround` (instant stand)
fix: Classify get-ups offline (face up, face down, on side, kneeling) with a pelvis/hand feature vector and choose the nearest to the ragdoll pose at Recover; add 2 to 3 dedicated get-up clips per class.

title: Ragdoll recovery can freeze the body mid-tumble
evidence: `Gameplay/Contact/RagdollState.cs:24,72` `MaxActive = 1.2f` forces Recover even if the bones still move (`SettleSpeed 0.7`); `RagdollRig.cs:307-317` freezes the physics pose at that frame and snapshots it
fix: Extend the budget to 2.0 s with a speed gate, or damp angular velocity during the last 0.3 s so the body comes to rest before the snapshot.

title: Solo get-up glides to the sim position, up to several metres, in 0.7 s
evidence: `ContactDirector.cs:419-428`: `k` ramp lerps `root` to `Ground(p)` over the last 0.7 s; the sim agent is down only 0.9 to 1.3 s (`Sim/CarrierMoves.cs:238` truck, `Sim/BlockEngagement.cs:345` pancake `Fall(0.9 + ...)`) but ragdoll (0.4 to 1.2 s) plus the get-up take (`st.End = getUp + 1.1`, `:347`) lasts about 2.5 s
fix: Freeze the sim agent in place for the ragdoll+get-up duration (set `Body.Fall` to the same length) or end the get-up at the sim position with a jog-in blend instead of a root lerp.

title: QB hit after the throw and roughing have no reaction
evidence: `ContactDirector.cs:97-115` ignores `SimEventType.QbHit` (`Sim/SimTypes.cs:28`); `Sim/TackleResolver.cs:43-58` logs `QbHit` (and may flag roughing, then `q.Body.Stumble(0.25f)`) but no view code consumes it, so the QB just keeps his follow-through
fix: Add a QbHit handler: short upper-body flinch/flail take (BoNES hit) with the rusher's shoulder-bump pair, no fall unless the sim says sack.

title: Fumble and recovery have no strip, scramble or pile
evidence: `ContactDirector.cs:97-115` ignores `Fumble`/`Recovery`; `Gameplay/Match/MatchAudio.cs:138-143` is the only consumer; `BallFollower.cs:56-63` just releases the ball
fix: Add a strip reaction on the carrier (arm snatch), a scramble-to-ball dive clip for nearby players and a recovery-pile take (reuse the gang joiners).

title: QB hit is only logged after the ball is released and only within 0.55 yd; hits and hurries before the throw (the sack that fails) leave no trace, and pressure (PocketPressure) never makes a throw late/inaccurate beyond bail
evidence: `TackleResolver.cs:44-62`; `OffenseAI.Qb.cs:560-583`
fix: Pre-release contact -> `Hurry` state (accuracy -12, 0.25 s stumble) and QB hit event when a rusher touches within r1+r2+0.2

title: Engaged defenders cannot tackle even if the ball carrier runs into their arms
evidence: `TackleResolver.cs:79`
fix: Allow `ArmTackle` when carrier within reach and Lev > -0.3: 35 % success, drag otherwise

title: Contact takes ignore GamePace.AnimationRate (0.88) and any future slow-down
evidence: `ContactDirector.cs:265-266,304,350` pass speed `1f`; `ContactSession.cs:65` `Advance(dt, speed = 1f)`; the v0.7 contract says tackle takes play at `AnimationRate` (`Sim/GamePace.cs:10-11`) and fall/shed/block do (`Gameplay/Player/SimAgentView.Flow.cs:78-85`). User note 10 asks to slow the game further
fix: Multiply clip speed and session `Advance` by `GamePace.AnimationRate`; read the same constant the sim uses so a later pace change propagates.

title: Throw / catch / hand-off clips are not on the game-pace rate that GamePace says they should be
evidence: `Sim/GamePace.cs:7-12` ("throw, tackle, catch, kick ... play at AnimationRate"); `Gameplay/Player/SimAgentView.Flow.cs:81-85` `PacedPlan` lists only Fallen, Tackled, Celebrate, Shed, Block, Jump, tackles
fix: Add Catch, Handoff, Juke, Spin, StiffArm, Truck to `PacedPlan`; keep Throw tied to the 0.42 s release frame

title: Delay of game is rolled as a random event at the snap (about 0.34 percent) even when the human snapped legally, in parallel with the real play-clock path
evidence: `PlaySimulation.cs:874-880` `acc += 0.0040f * (1.55f - qbAw)` -> DelayOfGame; `PlaySimulation.PreSnap.cs:225-232` `CallDelayOfGame()`
fix: Remove the random roll for director-driven plays (`!Options.AutoSnap`)

title: Snap-to-whistle averages 3.8 s run / 4.8 s pass against about 4.8 / 5.6 in the NFL, so every play ends early
evidence: `Docs/QA/v070/engine_pace.md:26`; `GamePace.cs:37`
fix: Targets 4.6 run / 5.5 pass: rows 11-16 lengthen get-off, reaction, wrap and lock-up; re-run `PaceAndPlayEndTests`

title: CPU/auto snap fires 0.6 s after the formation settles; no cadence, no read time, the defense never gets to shift
evidence: `PlaySimulation.cs:22` `AutoSnapDelay = 0.6f`; `Gameplay/Match/MatchFlow.cs:323` default 0.6
fix: 1.4-2.2 s (random per play) with a snap-count window; keep user snaps instant

title: Defenders break on the thrown ball after 0.16 s (elite) to 0.58 s: faster than a human visual reaction (0.25-0.30 s)
evidence: `DefenseAI.cs:629` `float react = 0.16f + (1f - aw)*0.30f;`
fix: `0.26 + (1-aw)*0.24`, +0.15 when not facing the passer (currently +0.12, `:632`)

title: Pass rushers move at full acceleration on tick 1 of the snap with no reaction time: RushUpdate runs from t = 0 and ReadDelay (0.2-0.52 s) is used only for run reads
evidence: `DefenseAI.cs:289-293,316`; `DefenseAI.cs:117-126`
fix: Get-off delay `0.12 + (1-accel01)*0.10 - 0.05 (cadence anticipation)`; 2-step burst via `AbilityTau` 0.8 for 0.25 s

title: Wrap window is 0.24 s from first contact to whistle (the carrier is already Tackled): a form tackle that takes 0.5-0.8 s is over before its clip can finish
evidence: `GamePace.cs:37` `TackleWrapSeconds = 0.24f`; `TackleResolver.cs:390` `EndPlayAfter(.., WrapSeconds)`
fix: 0.50 s (0.70 s for BigHit/gang), keep spotting at contact

title: Punt snap-to-kick is about 1.2 s (NFL operation is 2.0-2.2 s)
evidence: `Sim/GamePace.cs:83` `PuntApproach = 0.5f`; `SpecialTeamsAI.cs:151` `ScheduleKick(S.Time + 0.5f)` (catch at about 0.7 s)
fix: `PuntApproach = 1.10f`, `ScheduleKick(S.Time + 1.1f)`; raise rush `Delay`s in the punt block play accordingly so blocks stay about 1 in 50.

title: Returner arrives at the catch on a constant run, no settle step
evidence: `SpecialTeamsAI.cs:447-450` `float spd = Math.Min(vmax, Math.Max(2f, need * 1.05f)); a.Want = to.Norm() * spd;`
fix: Target the catch point 0.5 s early, stop and square up for 0.35 s (face the kicker, hands up), then adjust with 0.25 vmax; only run onto short/low kicks.

title: Catch animation starts after the ball is already caught (no lead-in for kicks)
evidence: `SpecialTeamsAI.cs:832` `S.PlayAction(a, AgentAction.Catch, 0.35f)` at the catch frame; `PlayStage.Flow.cs:36-46` pre-reach logic only for `BallState.Pass`
fix: Extend `FlowAction` to `BallState.Kick` for the returner: start the catch at `eta <= CatchReachSeconds` using the predicted `PredictCatchTime()`.

title: Kick approach path length does not match the clip's root travel (foot sliding)
evidence: Sim path 4.4 yd (about 4.0 m) in `KickoffApproach = 1.27/0.88 = 1.44 s` (`GamePace.cs:69`); `Docs/QA/photoreal_v2.md:48` clip has "2.5 m of hip travel (2 - 3 approach steps)"
fix: Either use a 5-7 step clip, or shorten the sim path to the clip travel (start (-2.0,-2.4), 2.5 m) and drive the speed profile from the clip's measured root speed.

title: Pace between plays: the CPU snaps 0.6 s after the formation settles and the autopilot at 0.9 s; the user-facing dead time is only a short fade
evidence: Code: MatchFlow.cs:323 autoSnapDelay 0.6f, MatchDirector.cs:33 AutopilotSnapDelay 0.9f, PlayClockLive/Dead 40/25 s; no huddle, cadence or shift (contact review rows 54, 55, 62). Target between-play tempo 12-18 s real time to snap with huddle break, cadence, motion and a visible audible/shift
fix: Add the pre-snap routine (huddle break walk 2.5 s, set 1.5 s, cadence 1.2-2.0 s with random hard count, optional shift) to CPU and autopilot snaps

title: Catch reach starts at ETA <= 0.34 s with a 0.22 s fade: hands not formed for short ETAs
evidence: `Gameplay/Match/PlayStage.Flow.cs:23,42`; `Player/AnimKit.V7.cs:95` `Lead` clamp 0.05-0.6; `Player/ActionAnimator.cs:174`
fix: Start at ETA 0.5 s and use the take's own gather phase; keep the pose weight at 1 by the hands-up frame

title: Requested 0.07 s contact fade-in is silently raised to 0.22 s
evidence: `ContactDirector.cs:265-266` (`Rig.Play(..., 1f, 0.07f, 0.35f, ...)`) vs `Gameplay/Player/ActionAnimator.cs:18,174,177` `MinFade = 0.22f`; the lead-in is 0.18 s so at the contact frame the clip weight is only Smooth(0.82) = 0.92 and the locomotion layer still shows through
fix: Either let contact takes pass a `forceFade` below `MinFade`, or lengthen `Lead` to 0.25 s so the clip is fully in at contact.

title: Session clock and animation clock can drift
evidence: `ContactSession.cs:65-69` advances by the clamped `dt` (`MatchDirector.cs:642` `min(deltaTime, 0.05)`) while `Gameplay/Player/ActionAnimator.cs:219` uses raw `Time.deltaTime`
fix: Drive the session time from `Rig.CurrentTime` of the playing clip (single source of truth), or pass the same dt to both.

title: Impact events (shake, rumble, hit sound) fire at session start, not at the hit
evidence: `ContactDirector.cs:268-269` `Fire(...)` inside `StartSession`; the bodies meet `Lead` (0.18 s) later; `CollisionFeel.OnImpact` and `Broadcast.OnImpact` (`MatchDirector.cs:1046-1051`) run immediately
fix: Schedule `Fire` at `Time >= Contact` of the session (tick-driven), and let `Look`/audio read the same moment.

title: The referee whistle is used as the audible/flip/switch sound
evidence: `MatchDirector.PreSnap.cs:70,84,190` `Audio.Whistle()`; also `MatchDirector.cs:609` for the kickoff press
fix: Use a UI/ crowd "call" sound for audibles and keep the whistle for dead balls.

title: Post-play shot plan can run longer than the wind-down and delays the next play
evidence: `Director/ShotRules.cs:39,89` budget 5.2 s (3.0 s for a user) vs `MatchDirector.cs:679` wind 2.9 s; `BroadcastDirector.cs:295-301` waits up to 3.2 s more
fix: Make the shot budget equal to the wind, trim the last shot to the wind end.

title: A touchdown costs about 20 s of non-play time
evidence: `MatchDirector.cs:679` 4.2 s wind, `BroadcastDirector.Shots.cs:196` shots 0.75 s delay + 2.4 + 1.7 s, auto replay `Replay/ReplayController.cs:92-118` (about 5 s real, plus 0.36x slow motion segment), drive summary (`BroadcastDirector.cs:310-316`), then the 0.22 s fade
fix: Overlap the celebration shots with the replay prep, cap replay A at 3 s, and make the replay skippable by default (it already is for the user, not for autopilot).

title: Official signal variants use unseeded randomness
evidence: `MatchOfficials.cs:258` `Random.Range(0, n)`; the replay recorder does not record officials (`BroadcastDirector` hides the crew in `SetCrewVisible(false)`), so a replay cannot show the same gesture
fix: Seed from `PlayNumber` and record the crew in the replay clip or keep them visible with a recorded pose.

title: The whistle plays twice on penalty plays
evidence: `MatchDirector.cs:712` `Audio.Whistle()` in `PenaltyFlow`, then `:1066` `React()` -> `Audio.Whistle()`; plus `Audio.OnEvent` handles `SimEventType.Whistle` (`MatchAudio.cs:142`)
fix: Single owner for the whistle (the sim's Whistle event or `React`, not both).

title: The man in motion walks at 3.4 yd/s to +-16 yd and has no stop point at the formation
evidence: `PlaySimulation.PreSnap.cs:17` `_motionLimitRight = 16f`; `:124` `new Vec2(MotionDir * 3.4f, 0f)`
fix: Jog 4.5 yd/s, stop at the far hash or the QB's far side

title: A lock-up may be won/lost at 0.45 s and the first rush move can start at 0.46-1.01 s after contact: pass-pro pairs flip within one second
evidence: `GamePace.cs:39`; `BlockEngagement.cs:216`, `:316`
fix: `MinEngageSeconds` 0.9 in pass mode, 0.6 in run mode; `MoveCooldown` pass 0.7-1.4 s

title: Swat/jump timing: the Jump clip also starts at the moment of deflection (PlayAction(d, Jump, 0.4)), after the contact decision; TryJump only fires when 0.34 s from the point
evidence: `CatchResolver.cs:447`; `DefenseAI.cs:684-685`
fix: Start the jump `0.22 s` before the predicted contact point; Deflect only plays the hit reaction

title: Kickoff tee ball height differs between view and launch point (visible pop)
evidence: `BallFollower.cs:126` ball at `_pos + up*0.1`; `SpecialTeamsAI.cs:377` launch `z = 0.3f`
fix: Make the view tee pose z = 0.27 m (0.30 yd) and launch from the same value; use one constant `KickTiming.TeeHeightYd`.

title: FG and punt contact moments are guessed when the timing table has no entry
evidence: `AnimKit.Extra.cs:28,41` `ClipTimingTable.Moment(c, 0.55f)` (55 % of clip length)
fix: Require measured contact for `k_fieldgoal` and `p_punt*` (ClipTimingBuilder) and log a warning when the fallback is used.

title: LOD evaluated every 4th frame per player
evidence: `Gameplay/Player/SimAgentView.cs:289` `((++_lodTick + AgentId) & 3) == 0`
fix: Evaluate every frame for players within 30 m of the camera (cost is a distance); 4-frame cadence only far away.

title: The pocket camera loses the ball on deep passes, punts and kicks
evidence: `Gameplay/Cameras/UserCameraMath.cs:111` `look.y = p.LookHeight` (0.5 m) and `:110` camera height fixed 6.4 m in Follow; `UserCameraView.cs:40-42` switches to ball focus with `fvel*0.35`, so the camera is only about 4.5 m behind the ball's ground point at `CarrierBack 10.5` minus lead (`UserCameraMath.cs:91`); a 10 to 20 m high ball is 30 to 60 deg above the optical axis (vertical FOV 42) and leaves the top of the frame
fix: In Follow with a ball in the air, aim at the ball's 3D position (`look.y = ball.y * 0.6`), raise the camera height with ball height, and keep the QB/receiver in the lower third until the ball is within 12 m of the receiver.

title: Camera lurches to the carrier framing at every snap
evidence: `UserCameraView.cs:39-42`: after the snap `b.State` is `Snap` (not Held) for the snap flight, so `follow = true` and the preset goes from pocket (Back 17, Height 9, FOV 46) to carrier (Back 10.5, Height 6.4, FOV 42, `UserCameraMath.cs:24`) and back when the QB catches it; smoothing taus are 0.22 to 0.55 s (`MatchCameraRig.cs:259-269`)
fix: Treat `BallState.Snap`/`Pitch` like Held (focus the QB, `follow = false`).

title: After a turnover the camera stays behind the old offense and the returner runs at it
evidence: `UserCameraView.cs:15` `ViewDir` depends only on `userSide`; `Flow.State.Possession` (hence `UserSide()`, `MatchDirector.cs:510`) changes only after the play, so during an interception/fumble return the returner runs toward the camera and is framed from the front
fix: When `sim.BallSide != userSide` and the holder is a runner, flip `ViewDir` to the holder's travel direction (smoothed), or switch to the Broadcast camera for the return.

title: Lateral clamp keeps sideline plays near the screen edge or out of it
evidence: `UserCameraMath.cs:76,108` `MaxLateral = 15.5` m while the sideline is 24.4 m from the centre (`PlayFrame.HalfWidthYd = 26.665 yd`); with FOV 42 to 46 at 10 to 17 m the carrier at x = 22 m sits about 6.5 m off centre, at the edge of the frame
fix: Clamp to about 20 m and widen the FOV by up to 6 deg as x grows; keep the ball carrier within the middle 70 percent of the screen.

title: Post-play tight shots are rigidly locked to the moving player
evidence: `Presentation/Director/ShotLibrary.cs:92-104` `TightCarrier` places the camera from `c.Subject()` and `c.Facing()` every frame with no damping; `Director/BroadcastCamera.cs:87-93` applies `_pos` directly; `BroadcastDirector.Shots.cs:73-77,52`
fix: Smooth `mid` and `face` with a critically damped spring (tau 0.25 s) and clamp the camera yaw rate to 90 deg/s.

title: No dedicated kick camera and the follow camera lags the ball
evidence: `Gameplay/Cameras/UserCameraView.cs:26` `los = ... sim.Agents[0].Pos; // kicking: behind the kicker` with the Classic 9 m / 17 m preset (`UserCameraMath.cs:23`); `:43` `if (fvel.magnitude > 12f) fvel = fvel.normalized * 12f;` while a kick travels 25-35 m/s
fix: Kick presets: kickoff low and wide behind the tee (height 3.5, back 11), FG low behind kicker framing the posts (height 2.4, back 8, FOV 38), punt high behind punter; after contact lead = ball velocity x 0.6, clamp 30 m/s.

title: Camera can sit inside the goalposts/stadium behind the end zone (verify in play)
evidence: `UserCameraMath.cs:112` clamps the camera to `z = +/-63` m, but the end line is 54.9 m and the camera stands on the hash x (about +/-3 m) at 9 m height when the offense is backed up (own 5 yd line gives z of about -58 m)
fix: Clamp to the back of the end zone plus 4 m, or raise and shorten `Back` when the focus is within 20 m of the goal line; test with a collider sweep against the goalpost prefab.

title: Default vertical FOV 46 is a wide lens; the reference asks for a long lens
evidence: `UserCameraMath.cs:23` `Fov = 46f` (Madden 48); `Docs/QA/REFERENCE_AllPro2K8.md` "fairly long lens (narrow-ish FOV)" and "elevated 6-9 m and 8-12 m behind the QB" vs Back 17 m from the LOS
fix: Raise the camera to 11 m and back to 22 m with FOV 30 to 34 for the same framing, or keep the framing but reduce lens distortion by moving the camera back and narrowing the FOV.

title: Broadcast camera stacks three smoothers and clamps before the end zones
evidence: `Gameplay/Cameras/MatchCameraRig.cs:195` `Lerp(..., 1 - exp(-7dt))`, `:66` `PositionDamping.z = 0.9`, `:68` rotation damping 0.5/0.6, plus lead `*0.55` (`:196`); `:197` `Clamp(z, -47, 47)` while the end zones reach 54.9 m
fix: Remove two of the three smoothers (keep the Cinemachine damping), clamp at 52 m and raise FOV slightly when the focus is past 47 m.

title: Broadcast camera swaps sidelines on every possession change
evidence: `MatchCameraRig.cs:127-133` `FollowOffset = (44 * side, 17, 0)` flips with `Frame.TowardsPlusZ`; `MatchDirector.cs:475` `Cams.SetFrame(_frame, true)` hard cuts
fix: Keep one sideline (the stadium's main camera side) and flip the offense direction on screen instead.

title: Pressing View blends the camera through the field
evidence: `MatchCameraRig.cs:53` `EaseInOut 0.6 s` for every camera pair including Behind to Broadcast (about 44 m lateral), `:104-114` `Cycle`
fix: Cut (0 s blend) between the broadcast and user cameras, or blend only FOV/height within the same family.

title: First-person camera lags the body and can disorient
evidence: `MatchCameraRig.cs:210` `_behindYaw` rotates at `40 + 60 * speed/8` deg/s, `:234` `_fpYaw` 220 deg/s; a sharp cut leaves the FP view 0.5 to 1 s behind the body yaw
fix: Drive `_fpYaw` from the view yaw (the head yaw of the animation) with a head-turn limit, and keep the look-assist for the ball only.

title: First-person anchor reads the head before the ground fit and IK run (verify in play)
evidence: `MatchCameraRig.cs:12` `DefaultExecutionOrder(-200)` and `:215-216` `Head.position` is read in its LateUpdate, before `SimAgentView.LateUpdate` (`SimAgentView.cs:188-193` `FitGround`, `Motion.Late`)
fix: Set the rig order to +10 and read the head after the IK, or compute the anchor in a post-IK callback.

title: Hit camera shake is nearly invisible and there is no hit-stop
evidence: `Gameplay/Match/CollisionFeel.cs:29` `MaxShiftMetres = 0.06`, `MaxShakeDegrees = 0.45`; `:65` `Shake(0.18 + 0.55*k*...)` squared (`:105`) so a normal tackle shakes by about 2 mm; no time-scale dip or camera punch
fix: Add a 40 to 60 ms hit-stop (animator speed 0.1) and a 1.5 deg camera kick on BigHit/Sack/Truck, keep the Perlin shake for the tail.

title: Player LODs are tuned so LOD0 never shows in gameplay; the main subjects sit at LOD1/LOD2
evidence: `Gameplay/Player/PlayerLod.cs:22` `Near = 9f, Mid = 22f, Far = 55f` vs Classic camera `UserCameraMath.cs:23` Height 9.0 / Back 17.0 (about 19 m to the QB, 22-40 m to the line)
fix: Switch from distance to projected screen height: LOD0 above 190 px, LOD1 above 95 px, LOD2 above 40 px (pass FOV and viewport). At 1080p that is about 24 / 48 / 110 m for a 1.9 m player.

title: LOD change is a hard SetActive swap with no cross-fade
evidence: `Art/PhotoPlayer.cs:398` `r.gameObject.SetActive(on)`; `PlayerLod.cs:86` `_photo.SetLevel(level)`; hysteresis only +-10 % (`:66-69`)
fix: Keep both LOD renderers alive for 0.25 s using HDRP `LODFadeMode.CrossFade` (dither) or an alpha-to-coverage fade; widen hysteresis to 20 %.

title: Low/Medium tier LOD bias crushes silhouettes
evidence: `Core/QualityTiers.cs:23-24` `LodBias = 0.45f` (Low), `0.7f` (Medium) => LOD1 below 4 m, LOD3 beyond 25 m
fix: Floor the bias at 0.8 and prefer cutting shadow cost; or keep LOD2 as the cap for the two featured players (QB, ball carrier).

title: Shadow cascades waste 4 % of the range near the camera and the last cascade spans 10.8-90 m
evidence: `Gameplay/Look/WeatherSystem.cs:226-227` `maxShadowDistance 90`, `cascadeShadowSplitCount (tier >= 2 ? 4 : 3)`, splits `0.04 / 0.12 / 0.3`
fix: Use splits `0.10, 0.25, 0.50` with 4 cascades on all tiers and max distance 110 (matches 25-50 m player range); Low/Medium 3 cascades `0.14, 0.40`.

title: Directional and spot shadows use medium PCF filtering
evidence: `Assets/_Project/Settings/PixHDRP.asset:322-323` `punctualShadowFilteringQuality: 1`, `directionalShadowFilteringQuality: 1`; `WeatherSystem.cs:142` sets `angularDiameter` expecting soft PCSS
fix: Set directional to High (2) so `angularDiameter 1.4` actually gives contact-hardening player shadows; keep max shadow map at 2048 (`:348`).

title: Floodlight player shadows are switched on and then switched off again by the tier code
evidence: `WeatherSystem.cs:162-163` `shadow = (tier >= 2 && n == "Flood_E6") ...`; then `QualityTiers.cs:25` `High: SpotShadows = false` and `:109` `l.shadows = LightShadows.None` run at the end of `Apply` (`:80`)
fix: Make `SpotShadows` true for High (index 2) and limit by lamp name instead; at night keep 2 rim lamps with shadows on High, 4 on Ultra.

title: Night games: players only get shadows from a 90 lux moon, so they float
evidence: `Core/Look/WeatherPresets.cs:181` night `SunLux = 90f`; `WeatherSystem.cs:28` `NightFloodScale = 0.2f`; `:162` only E6/E7 cast
fix: Raise moon to 350 lux with `shadowDimmer 0.6`, add a baked-looking contact blob (issue 52), and let 4 floods cast soft shadows at High.

title: No contact shadow / blob under feet on low tiers; screen-space contact shadows only 0.25 m
evidence: `QualityTiers.cs:23-24` `Ssao = false`/`ContactShadows = false` on Low, `ContactShadows = false` on Medium; `SceneBuilder.cs:64` `cs.length.Override(0.25f)`
fix: Add a 0.9 m soft decal/quad "foot shadow" per player (alpha 0.35, tinted to ambient) on ALL tiers; raise contact shadow length to 0.45.

title: Jersey numbers are small for the default camera
evidence: `Editor/Tools/V6ArtBuilder.cs:516-517` `numberBack` height `605/4096`, `numberFront` `482/4096`; Classic camera about 75 px per meter at 17 m
fix: Scale back number +20 % (726/4096) and front +25 % (600/4096) with outline width +30 %; keep `JerseyLook.For` contrast gate 3.4 (`PixLook.cs:26`).

title: Rain streaks die before they reach the ground
evidence: `Gameplay/Look/WeatherFx.cs:56` lifetime `0.9-1.25`, `:60` `y = -19`, `:158` emitter `y = 24` => travel 17-24 m of 24 m (average stop 3.6 m above grass)
fix: Lifetime `1.35-1.6` or spawn height 18 with lifetime `1.0-1.2`; splashes (`:65-75`) then align with the streak ends.

title: Day sun is a fixed 58 degree high noon with a fixed azimuth
evidence: `Core/Look/WeatherPresets.cs:173` `SunElevation = 58f`, `:168` `SunAzimuth = 38f`
fix: Day elevation 38-44 deg, azimuth tied to stadium orientation and the quarter (shadows fall toward the main camera and lengthen in Q4); gives readable player modelling.

title: Dusk sun at 5.5 degrees throws 10x body-length shadows over the pitch
evidence: `WeatherPresets.cs:177` `SunElevation = 5.5f`
fix: 13-15 deg with `SunLux 38000`; lengthen over the game from 15 to 9 deg.

title: Crowd is static baked billboards with no animation or reaction
evidence: `Editor/Build/SceneBuilder.cs:205-218` quads in one mesh, `shadowCastingMode Off`, `ForceNoMotion`; `World/CrowdInfo.cs:6-9` only a `FanCount`
fix: Vertex-shader wave/bob driven by a global `_PixCrowdEnergy` set from play results (cheer, groan, wave on TD); two-frame flipbook for the first 12 rows.

title: DLSS/FSR default Off, balanced quality, MSAA off: edges depend on 100 % TAA
evidence: `PixSettings.cs:64` `GetI("upscaler", 0)`; `UpscalerControl.cs:56-57` `DLSSPerfQualitySetting = 1u`, FSR2 `1u` ("balanced"); `PixHDRP.asset:271` `msaaSampleCount: 1`, `:374` `DLSSPerfQualitySetting: 0`; `SceneBuilder.cs:233-234` TAA sharpen 0.4
fix: Default "Auto": DLSS Quality (2) or DLAA when the GPU reports DLSS, else FSR2 Quality; settings screen shows the active mode; set the asset default to Quality.

title: Kick follow-through: the planted foot is not locked at contact
evidence: `Gameplay/Player/BodyMotion.cs:142` `LockFoot` runs for locomotion; kicker action is clip-owned (`SimAgentView.cs:227,235`) and excluded from ground fit
fix: Add plant-foot IK weight 1.0 across the contact +-0.12 s in the kick plan (`ClipPlan` field `PlantFoot`), using `LimbIK.Apply` to keep the sole on the turf.

title: Facing loop + clip facing table: 12 bone lookups x 22 players per frame
evidence: `Player/SimAgentView.cs:274` `BodyHeading.Measure` in `LateUpdate`; `Player/BodyHeading.cs:42-49`
fix: Cache bones, measure at 15 Hz or only when the playing clip changes

title: Wasted per-frame work: stride tracker with trim off, animator state polling
evidence: `Player/BodyMotion.cs:140,148` `TrackStride` runs although `StrideMatchEnabled = false`; `Player/LocomotionAnimator.cs:112` `GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo` per player per frame
fix: Skip `TrackStride` when disabled; only poll the action layer when a trigger was sent

title: Clip name strings and playable creation at every replan: GC and hitches at the snap and formation shifts
evidence: `Player/AnimKit.cs:139,262-265,323-325` `.name` (allocates in the Unity API) in nested loops, `new[]` at `:252`; `Player/StanceClips.cs:55-64` doubles the loop for mirrors; `Player/ActionAnimator.cs:165,205` create/destroy a playable per `Play`
fix: Cache clip metadata (tokens, mirror) at load, pool playables, bound replans per frame

title: CullUpdateTransforms plus additive LateUpdate rotations accumulate off screen
evidence: `Player/SimAgentView.cs:79` culling mode; `Player/BodyMotion.cs:123-126,223-224` multiply the current bone rotation every frame
fix: Skip `Motion.Late` and `FitGround` when the avatar is culled; reset bone rotations on re-enable

title: Skinned updateWhenOffscreen = false with ragdoll/lying poses
evidence: `Player/PlayerAvatar.cs:139`
fix: Enable `updateWhenOffscreen` for the 2-3 s of a ragdoll/fall, or enlarge bounds

title: Ragdoll collides with the ground plane only, no feet/hands, no bodies
evidence: `RagdollRig.cs:51-52` all layers ignore layer 20 except 21; `:175-189` parts list has no feet, hands or shoulders; `:59-61` flat 260 x 260 box ground
fix: Add foot/hand colliders, a body-vs-body layer pair with a soft material for the first 0.5 s, and sample the turf height where the stadium has crown.

title: Ball at rest hovers 3 cm and rolls as a sphere
evidence: `Sim/BallSim.cs:12,255-285` `BallRadius = 0.13` yd (0.119 m) as ground height; a lying football's centre is about 0.085 m; `BallFollower.cs:94` rest orientation slerps to downfield regardless of how it landed
fix: Offset the drawn ball by -0.03 m at rest and let the rest orientation follow the last rolling axis; add a 2 to 3 bounce wobble.

title: Only the referee signals; other officials never gesture (dead code)
evidence: `Gameplay/Match/MatchOfficials.cs:263` `does = all /  / p.Role == "R" /  / (... && false)`
fix: Let the umpire/back judge signal incomplete and the line judge signal first down as separate clips, and add a "spot the ball" action for the umpire.

title: The dead-ball signal and whistle animation are never triggered
evidence: `MatchOfficials.cs:12,253` `DeadBall` exists but no caller (`MatchDirector.cs:626,728,1099-1103` fire Timeout/Penalty/TD/FirstDown/Incomplete/Safety only)
fix: Fire `DeadBall` on every whistle where nothing else is signalled and play a short whistle-arm clip.

title: Field markers are flat unlit strips 2 cm above the turf
evidence: `Gameplay/Match/FieldMarkers.cs:13` `LineY = 0.022f`, `:171-178` `SetLines`; `RouteOverlay.cs:19` 3.6 to 4.8 cm; the first-down line has no glow/edge, ignores the crowned turf and z-fights with painted lines at grazing angles
fix: Use decals/projected quads with `ZTest` offset and a slight emissive edge; raise to 3 cm and add a depth bias.

title: Kicked ball orientation uses the flat (XZ) velocity: no nose pitch with the arc
evidence: `BallFollower.cs:81-82` `Vector3 axis0 = flat.sqrMagnitude > 0.01f ? flat.normalized : ...`
fix: Use `vel.normalized` for the long axis and add the tumble about the lateral axis cross(up,vel); nose points down on descent.

title: Tier shadow distance only ever lowers; HDRP uses the volume value anyway
evidence: `QualityTiers.cs:93` `Mathf.Min(QualitySettings.shadowDistance, tier.ShadowDistance)`; tiers 120/150 never apply because `WeatherSystem.cs:226` forces 90
fix: Set `maxShadowDistance` from `Tier.ShadowDistance` inside `BuildVolume` and allow raising on tier change.

title: No motion blur ever, although tiers advertise it
evidence: `WeatherSystem.cs:225` `mbl.intensity.Override(0f)` at priority 50 overrides the scene's 0.12 (`Editor/Build/SceneBuilder.cs:61`); the comment "the drama volume adds a little" is false (`:257-266` has no MotionBlur)
fix: Camera-only motion blur 0.18, shutter 0.35, object MB off in `BuildVolume`; drama 0.30 for replays.

title: No depth of field in live play (flat image of the whole stadium)
evidence: DoF exists only in `Presentation/Director/BroadcastCamera.cs:42-48`; `WeatherSystem` adds no `DepthOfField`
fix: Add a very subtle physical-camera DoF (aperture f/4, focus = ball/QB distance, far blur only) to the live volume for High/Ultra; keep off on Low/Medium.

title: Footstep wear is stamped at the body root every 0.16 s, not at the feet
evidence: `Gameplay/Look/LookDirector.cs:181-183` `Vector3 p = v.transform.position; wear.Footstep(p, ...)` and `:163` `_stepClock >= 0.16f`
fix: Stamp at `LeftFoot/RightFoot` bone when its vertical speed crosses zero (foot plant), alternating; kickers stamp the plant foot at contact.

title: Wear stamps are silently dropped when the queue is full
evidence: `Gameplay/Look/FieldWear.cs:93` `if (_rt == null \ / \ / _queue.Count >= 512) return;` while `MaxStampsPerFrame = 96` (`:17`)
fix: Drop oldest footsteps first and never drop `Divot` stamps; raise `MaxStampsPerFrame` to 160 on High/Ultra.

title: Midfield logo re-rotates to the camera axis every play
evidence: `LookDirector.cs:72` `FieldLogo.Instance.FaceCamera(Camera.main)` in `BeginPlay`; `FieldLogo.cs:77-79` snaps yaw to multiples of 90
fix: Orient once per half toward the main broadcast sideline; never rotate between plays.

title: Dirt is one soil colour with no kick, no cleaning and no sweat
evidence: `Gameplay/Look/PixLook.cs:142` `new Color(0.12f, 0.08f, 0.045f)`; `Core/Look/DirtModel.cs:7-32` no event for kicks/catches/halftime
fix: Per-field soil colour (turf vs dirt), light wipe of 40 % at halftime/injury timeout, add `KickPlant` event (knees/seat 0).

title: Ball has no flight cue (no trail / landing marker) and is shadow-only for visibility
evidence: `BallFollower.cs:35-52` Create has no trail or marker; only `shadowCastingMode = On` (`:47`)
fix: Thin additive trail (0.35 s, alpha 0.25) on kicks and passes above 15 m, landing ring for the returner on punts/kickoffs (2K8 style).

title: Weather particles ignore time scale and scene lighting
evidence: `WeatherFx.cs:44` `main.useUnscaledTime = true`; unlit `PIX/FxUnlit` with only a tint (`:101-105`)
fix: Use scaled time (slow-mo replays keep rain slow); multiply tint by floodlight intensity and give streaks a screen-space bright rim near the flood lamps.

title: Overcast shadow dimmer 0.45 leaves players with no grounding
evidence: `WeatherSystem.cs:143` `shadowDimmer = Mathf.Lerp(1f, 0.45f, p.CloudCover)`
fix: Floor at 0.7 and compensate with SSAO radius 0.9 on overcast/rain.

title: Empty sky: no cloud layer or volumetric clouds
evidence: `Settings/PixHDRP.asset:229` `supportVolumetricClouds: 0`; `WeatherSystem.cs:189-200` sky overrides only, `CloudCover` only dims
fix: Add a `CloudLayer` override (cheap) driven by `CloudCover`, scrolling at wind speed.

title: Film grain, vignette and bloom are on in the default grade (not "clean/bright")
evidence: `WeatherPresets.cs:165,167` `Vignette 0.2`, `FilmGrain 0.08`, `Bloom 0.14`; `WeatherSystem.cs:228` bloom `threshold 0.9`
fix: Live play: grain 0.0, vignette 0.12, bloom threshold 1.15 / intensity 0.08 (white jerseys and lines stop haloing); keep grain in the drama volume only.

title: AA flips to FXAA for 3 frames after every broadcast cut
evidence: `Presentation/Director/BroadcastCamera.cs:77-84` `FastApproximateAntialiasing; _cutFrames = 3`
fix: Reset TAA history (`hd.RequestTemporalAntialiasingReset`/camera `ResetHistory`) instead of switching mode; no visible AA change.

title: Pad shell colour lags a re-dressed player by up to 20 frames
evidence: `Art/PhotoPadTint.cs:18` `public int interval = 20;` (Sync via `LateUpdate`)
fix: Sync immediately from `PlayerAvatar.SetColors`/`SetHelmetColors` (event) instead of polling.

title: LOS and first-down strips do not receive shadows
evidence: `Gameplay/Match/FieldMarkers.cs:43` `r.shadowCastingMode = Off; r.receiveShadows = false;`
fix: `receiveShadows = true` (the markers use a lit material) so player shadows fall across the blue/yellow lines.

title: SSR only reflects surfaces at smoothness 0.92+, so wet turf and puddles get no reflection
evidence: `SceneBuilder.cs:63` `ssr.minSmoothness = 0.92f`; `WeatherPresets.cs:208` rain wetness 1
fix: In rain presets lower `minSmoothness` to 0.7 via the weather volume (add a `ScreenSpaceReflection` override).

title: SSAO, SSR and contact-shadow tier toggles hit scene volumes only; the weather volume (priority 50) never defines them
evidence: `QualityTiers.cs:103` `Set<ScreenSpaceAmbientOcclusion>(...) Set<ScreenSpaceReflection> Set<ContactShadows> Set<MotionBlur>`; `WeatherSystem.cs:168-235` adds MotionBlur (0) but no SSAO/SSR/ContactShadows override
fix: Put the tier-controlled effects (AO 0.7, contact shadows 0.45, SSR) into the weather volume so one place defines the in-play look and a tier switch is deterministic.

title: SSGI exists only on Ultra, the one tier with 1.4 LOD bias
evidence: `QualityTiers.cs:26` `Ssgi = true` only for Ultra; `WeatherSystem.cs:234` `if (QualityTiers.Ssgi)`
fix: Offer SSGI half-res on High; it fixes the flat ambient on the white jerseys in shade.

title: Upscaler setup is skipped in the editor, so editor-captured audit renders never match the player build
evidence: `Gameplay/Core/UpscalerControl.cs:59` `if (changed && !Application.isEditor) { rps.dynamicResolutionSettings = dr; ... }`
fix: Apply in the editor as well behind a `-pixUpscaler` flag (restore on exit) so lookdev screenshots and the shipped look agree.
